items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: having had the opportunity of working with ... the late Almond Hug

ctx.x: Oh sure, well I knew Monk. He was the first jazz musician in New Orleans that I ever got to know was Monk. And that was when he was working on Broadway in the Alcohol Factory. Right. Walking around in it all day long.

You know Dick, I really feel very good of having had the opportunity of working with fellas like the late Monk Hable, the late Larry Shields, and Jeff Riddick, and the late Almond Hug. Which Shields? Larry Shields. Harry Shields.
